name: account.me
description: The caller's account and the brands they reach, read when they sign in.
sql: select jsonb_build_object('user', brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(u)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(u.created_at), 'deactivatedAt', brandbase.iso(u.deactivated_at)), 'brands', coalesce((select jsonb_agg((brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(b)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(b.created_at))) order by b.position, b.id) from brandbase.brands b), '[]')) as result from brandbase.users u where u.id = brandbase.caller()
